documents.text: Client notes for the upcoming booking: cancellation prior to the deadline still incurs a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros, so advise accordingly. Good news on logistics; arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, requiring no earlier contact or special request from the guest. Regarding amenities, a swimming area is mentioned in the brochure, yet its specific location, price, and booking access conditions remain unstated. For activities, clarify that the quoted amount covers accommodation only; should they wish to take a hike with a guide, a separate 38 euro payment is required. Ensure the client understands these distinctions before finalizing the itinerary.

Agent: Hello, checking on the Alder offer details. Customer: Yes, specifically about refunds and extras. Agent: Before the cancellation cutoff, the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. However, please note that no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary for late arrivals. Customer: What about the pool? Agent: The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Customer: And the guided walk? Agent: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Just remember, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied in the unbooked offer policy. This applies to the selected Alder offer, not the distractor Birch one.

Booking Confirmation: Your reservation is secured. Please note that neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented in our current records. Regarding arrival, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. While a swimming area is mentioned, its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated. Important update on activities: although the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, this current selected term completely replaces the old policy. Consequently, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied under the previous rules. Please ensure you have prior permission for the 01:30 arrival.

Frequently Asked Questions: Q: What is the refund policy? A: Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. Q: Can I arrive at 01:30? A: Yes, arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. Q: Is the pool free? A: No, the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Q: Is the guided hike included? A: We have two equally current and authoritative policies that disagree. One states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, while the other says the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Neither overrides the other, so applicable terms are unresolved.
